title: Amanda Knox: Murder on Trial in Italy
description: College student Amanda Knox (Hayden Panettiere) stands trial in Italy, accused of murdering her roommate, Meredith Kercher (Amanda Fernando Stevens).

title: Beyond the Headlines: The Kamiyah Mobley Story With Robin Roberts
description: Kidnapped at birth in 1998 by a woman she grew up believing was her mother, Kamiyah Mobley sits down exclusively with award-winning journalist Robin Roberts for a revealing interview about life since her true identity was exposed.

title: Devil on Campus: The Larry Ray Story
description: When con man Larry Ray moves into his daughter's dorm, he enthralls her friends while preying on their insecurities and fears. As the students get pulled deeper into his web of deceit, Ray's manipulation further alienates them from their families.
